notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce {3}{B}{G}.
description:
Activate Diamond Valley by tapping it and sacrificing Great Whale, gaining you 5 life.
Activate Atzal's second ability by paying {3}{B}{G} and tapping it, returning Great Whale to the battlefield.
Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping Atzal, Diamond Valley, and five other lands that can produce {3}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Journey to Eternity // Atzal, Cave of Eternity
